name: Johnny Foley's

access.summary: N Judah to Powell Station, then a two-block walk
access.detail: Take the N Judah inbound from 21st Ave & Judah to Powell Station, then walk two blocks north on Powell to O'Farrell; 243 O'Farrell is between Powell and Cyril Magnin. The 38 Geary also stops one block away. About 35 minutes.

source.label: Official Johnny Foley's contact page
source.quote: 243 O'Farrell Street between Powell St & Cyril Magnin Lane San Francisco, CA 94102 — BAR HOURS Wednesday 3:00pm - midnight / Thursday 3:00pm - midnight / Friday 3:00pm - 1:30am / Saturday 11:00am - 1:30am / Sunday 11:00am - midnight / CLOSED Monday & Tuesday. Live music in the Main Bar 10:00pm - 1:00am, dueling pianos in The Cellar 9pm - Midnight, every Friday & Saturday.

flags: Kitchen stops at 10:00 PM every night even though the bar runs to 1:30 AM Friday and Saturday — arrive before 10 PM for food.
Closed Monday and Tuesday. The site also notes occasional special conference hours, so check before a trip during large downtown events.

verification.method: Official contact page checked on 2026-09-06; address, separate bar and kitchen hours, and the Friday/Saturday 1:30 AM close were all transcribed verbatim from the venue's own page.
